NumericEntityUnescaper.replace:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Decodes numeric HTML entities in a string by replacing valid '&#...;' sequences with the corresponding Unicode characters, treating non-entity text literally, and returning the accumulated result when scanning stops before the final two input positions or when an entity boundary is malformed." replace]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> string </REF>: string "Input string that may contain decimal or hexadecimal numeric HTML entities to decode."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "Decoded output string; may be partial because the outer loop stops before the last two positions and certain malformed entity conditions return immediately."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize out as an empty list, pos as 0, and length as the length of string. RESULT out]
            [COMMAND Enter the outer while loop, continuing while pos is less than length - 2 so string[pos], string[pos+1], and string[pos+2] are all valid to inspect. RESULT loop]
            [COMMAND At the start of each outer-loop iteration, check with short-circuit evaluation whether string[pos] is '&' and, only if true, whether string[pos+1] is '#'; if this entity marker is absent, append string[pos] to out, increment pos by 1, and proceed to the next iteration. RESULT out]
            [COMMAND In the entity-marker branch of the outer loop, set start to pos + 2, set is_hex to False, and set first_char to string[start]. RESULT start]
            [COMMAND If first_char is 'x' or 'X', increment start by 1 and set is_hex to True to indicate a hexadecimal entity. RESULT start_adjusted]
            [COMMAND After any hex-marker adjustment, if start equals length, immediately return ''.join(out). RESULT out]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, in the same entity-parsing branch, set end to start and run the inner while loop, incrementing end while end is less than length and self.is_hex_char(string[end]) is true. RESULT end]
            [COMMAND After the inner scan, if end is less than length and string[end] is ';', try to convert string[start:end] to an integer using base 16 if is_hex is True, otherwise using base 10. RESULT entity_value]
            [COMMAND If the conversion succeeds, append chr(entity_value) to out, set pos to end + 1, and continue the outer loop, skipping the entire entity. RESULT out]
            [COMMAND When the outer loop exits, return ''.join(out) without appending any unprocessed characters from position length - 2 onward. RESULT out]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The conversion attempt int(string[start:end], 16 or 10) raises an exception, such as ValueError or TypeError.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return ''.join(out) immediately, aborting further scanning of string. RESULT out]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: An entity-looking sequence is found, but after scanning the run of hex/digit characters the next character is not a semicolon (or the end of string is reached).]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append the current '&' character from string[pos] to out, increment pos by 1, and resume the outer loop; subsequent characters are processed only if they occur before the loop's final two-position boundary. RESULT out]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
NumericEntityUnescaper.is_hex_char:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Implements a hexadecimal-character check by returning true when char.isdigit() is true or when char.lower() falls in the inclusive lexicographic range from 'a' to 'f'." is_hex_char]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> char </REF>: string "The input string to test for hexadecimal-character acceptance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: boolean "True if char.isdigit() is true, or if char.lower() is lexicographically between 'a' and 'f' inclusive; otherwise false."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Accept the input string char. RESULT char]
            [COMMAND Evaluate char.isdigit() and store the boolean result as is_digit. RESULT is_digit]
            [COMMAND If is_digit is true, short-circuit and return true immediately without evaluating char.lower(). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: is_digit is false]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute char.lower() once and store the lowercase value as lower_char. RESULT lower_char]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether lower_char is lexicographically greater than or equal to 'a' and less than or equal to 'f'. RESULT hex_letter_result]
            [COMMAND Return hex_letter_result as the final return value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
